description: This file defines the IPC service RPMsg API, including structures, callback types, and function prototypes for initializing, deinitializing, and registering endpoints in an RPMsg-based IPC system within the Zephyr project.

methods.name: ipc_rpmsg_init
methods.description: Initializes an RPMsg instance with specified parameters including role, buffer size, shared memory, and callback for name service announcement.

methods.name: ipc_rpmsg_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes an RPMsg instance for a given role.

methods.name: ipc_rpmsg_register_ept
methods.description: Registers an endpoint with a specified RPMsg instance and role.
